title: FDA will miss rare decision deadline for Savara candidate after three-month delay
snippet: Savara shares dropped 18% on the news, though analysts remain confident in approval, instead pointing to potential “bandwidth issues” at the FDA.

title: RevMed pads Rasonque’s first-line survival advantage in pancreatic cancer with early data
snippet: The new data could help boost Revolution Medicines beyond the currently estimated $14.5 billion in peak sales for the recently approved RAS(ON) inhibitor, Truist Securities predicts.

title: An Insmed takeout by Sanofi would be ‘clear strategic fit’ in respiratory space
snippet: If it came to fruition, the rumored deal between Sanofi and Insmed would likely be the year’s largest, with one analyst putting a potential value for the biotech as high as $40 billion.

title: Merck-Kelun ADC scores survival win in Phase 3 gastroesophageal cancer trial
snippet: Licensed from Kelun-Biotech, Merck’s TROP2-targeting antibody drug conjugate sac-TMT improved overall survival in advanced gastroesophageal cancer while missing on two secondary endpoints.
